           ABOUT CGN MINING                                                        關於中廣核礦業
           The Company is incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed on the     本公司註冊地為開曼群島，為一家在聯交
           main board of the Stock Exchange (stock code: 01164). The principal     所主板上市的公司（股票代號：01164），
           activities are the development and trade of natural uranium resources   本集團主要從事天然鈾資源的開發與貿
           used by nuclear energy enterprises, with a view to be one of the top    易，旨在成為核電站天然鈾資源的主要供
           suppliers of natural uranium resources for nuclear power plants.        應商之一。

            Nuclear power market forecast                                            核電市場形勢研判

            Low-carbon has never been more widely recognized in the world            低碳從未像今天這樣獲得世界更廣泛的共
            like it is today. On 22 September 2020, the Chinese President            識。2020年9月22日，中國國家主席習近
            Xi Jinping announced at the 75th session of the United Nations           平在第75屆聯合國大會上表示「中國將提
            General Assembly that “China will scale up its nationally determined     高國家自主貢獻力度，採取更加有力的政
            contributions and adopt more vigorous policies and measures, strive      策和措施，二氧化碳排放力爭於2030年前

OPINION                                                                    意見
We have audited the consolidated financial statements of CGN Mining        我們已審核載於第144至278頁之中廣核
Company Limited (the “Company”) and its subsidiaries (collectively         礦業有限公司（「貴公司」）及其附屬公司
referred to as the “Group”) set out on pages 144 to 278, which             （統稱為「貴集團」
                                                                                   ）之綜合財務報表，該等
comprise the consolidated statement of financial position as at 31         綜合財務報表包括於2020年12月31日的
December 2020, and the consolidated statement of profit or loss and        綜合財務狀況表，及截至該日止年度之綜
other comprehensive income, consolidated statement of changes              合損益及其他全面收益表、綜合權益變動

     The Group measures the loss allowance for trade receivables         本集團計量的應收賬款虧損撥備等

     receivables are estimated using a provision matrix by reference     預期信貸虧損乃經參考債務人過往
     to past default experience and creditworthiness of the debtor       違約記錄及信譽以及對債務人現時
     and an analysis of the debtor’s current financial position,         財務狀況的分析後採用撥備矩陣估
     adjusted for factors that are specific to the debtors, general      計，並就債務人的特定因素、債務
     economic conditions of the industry in which the debtors            人營運所處行業的整體經濟情況以
     operate and an assessment of both the current as well as the        及對報告日期現時和預測狀況方向
     forecast direction of conditions at the reporting date.             的評估予以調整。


     For other receivables, the Group measures the loss allowance        就其他應收款項而言，本集團計量
     equal to 12-month ECLs, unless when there is a significant          與12個月預期信貸虧損等額的虧損
     increase in credit risk since initial recognition, the Group        撥備，除非信貸風險自首次確認以
     recognises lifetime ECLs. The assessment of whether lifetime        來顯著增加，則本集團會確認全期
     ECLs should be recognised is based on significant increase          預期信貸虧損。評估是否應確認全
     in the likelihood or risk of a default occurring since initial      期預期信貸虧損，乃基於自首次確
     recognition.                                                        認起出現違約的可能性或風險是否
                                                                         顯著增加。

41. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                                41. 資本風險管理
     The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the            本集團管理其資本，以確保本集團
     Group will be able to continue as a going concern while                 旗下實體能夠持續經營業務，並透
     maximising the return to shareholders through the optimisation          過更完善平衡債務及權益，以為股
     of the debt and equity balance. The Group’s overall strategy            東帶來最大回報。本集團整體策略
     remains unchanged from prior year.                                      與去年維持不變。


     The capital structure of the Group consists of net debt, which          本集團之資本結構包括淨負債（包
     includes loans from a fellow subsidiary and leases liabilities,         括應收一間同系附屬公司貸款及租
     net of cash and cash equivalents and equity attributable to             賃負債），扣除現金及現金等值項
     owners of the Company, comprising issued share capital                  目以及本公司擁有人應佔權益（當
     and reserves. The directors of the Company review the                   中包括已發行股本及儲備）。本公
     capital structure on a regular basis. As a part of this review,         司董事定期檢討資本結構。作為檢
     the directors of the Company consider the cost of capital               討其中一環，本公司董事考慮資本
     and the risks associated with each class of capital, and take           成本及與各類資本相關的風險，並
     appropriate actions to adjust the Group’s capital structure.            就此採取適當行動調整本集團資本
                                                                             結構。


     Consistent with others in the industry, the Group monitors              與業內其他公司做法一致，本集團
     capital on the basis of the gearing ratio. This ratio is calculated     以資本負債比率監察資本。該比率
     as net debt divided by total capital. Net debt is calculated as         以淨負債除以資本總額計算。淨負
     total borrowings less cash and cash equivalents. Total capital is       債按借貸總額減現金及現金等值項
     calculated as equity as shown in the consolidated statement             目計算。資本總額按綜合財務狀況
     of financial position plus net debt.                                    表所列的權益加上淨負債計算。
